toni: FYI customer reported emails in crash logs. looks like iOS background uploads sometimes lose X-Request-Id so server redaction misses entries :grimacing:
evan: steps to repro?
toni: minimal repro in sampleapp-ios. create background URLSession upload, set X-Request-Id on URLRequest, toggle airplane mode so OS persists/resumes task. ~9% of resumed uploads reach server without header.
priya: can you paste snippet?
toni: ```swift
var req = URLRequest(url: uploadURL)
req.addValue(requestId, forHTTPHeaderField: "X-Request-Id")
let task = backgroundSession.uploadTask(with: req, fromFile: fileURL)
task.resume()
```
priya: backgroundSession = URLSession(configuration: .background(withIdentifier:)). OS may archive tasks; some headers don't roundtrip when system recreates them.
qa-bot: repro attempt: simulate airplane mode, force app restart, wait for OS resume. server logs: 9/100 missing X-Request-Id, matches redaction-missed metric spike.
ops-bot: alert: redaction-missing-count +120 at 07:23 UTC -> paging.
evan: short-term mitigation: set SDK default logging to .info for release builds to reduce PII debug logs.
toni: canary already flipped debug->info for beta, dropped raw PII logs ~60%, but still need header fix.
priya: quick workaround: put request id into query param `?req_id=` since URL is preserved by the system for background tasks. ugly but reliable. watch caching/CDN implications.
evan: long-term options: 1) persist metadata and re-create request with headers on resume, 2) include request id in body or query so OS preserves it, or 3) rely on trace propagation headers that may survive serialization.
priya: server-side fallback: if no X-Request-Id, try traceparent or x-b3-traceid for redaction lookup as secondary key and emit metric for missing header.
toni: action items: 1) i'll open sampleapp PR adding `?req_id=` fallback + integration test that simulates background resume, 2) priya to prototype persistent wrapper to reattach headers, 3) evan to add server heuristic to try trace headers as fallback and a metric for missing X-Request-Id.
evan: reminder: any change that puts ids in URLs must ensure ids are not leaked to CDNs or in logs. include validation in tests.
toni: will add README note for sampleapp and include repro script. TL;DR: URLSession background tasks can drop custom headers; short fix = URL param fallback + logging defaults; long fix = persistent wrapper or OTEL trace propagation support. :lock: :white_check_mark:
